claim: The 14 April 2017 Meethotamulla waste-landslide response recorded 32 deaths, 8 missing people, 79 destroyed homes and 264 affected families.

metric.value: 32 dead; 8 missing; 79 homes destroyed; 264 families affected
metric.denominator: people/homes/families directly recorded in the Meethotamulla collapse response
metric.basis: Government/World Bank project environmental assessment event totals
metric.source_definition: directly affected by the dumpsite collapse and immediate response

bounded_by: These event totals establish the municipal-waste disaster trigger, not the national share of plastic pollution.
